text.EN: That's a horde. We fighting through or pulling back?
text.TL: Kawan iyan. Lalaban ba tayo o uurong?

text.EN: Look at that crowd. Do we stand our ground or run?
text.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila. Maninindigan ba tayo o tatakbo?

text.EN: Huge pack ahead. What's the call: fight or retreat?
text.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Anong pasya: lalaban o aatras?

text.EN: That is a serious horde. Do we engage or bypass?
text.TL: Matinding kawan 'yan. Lalabanan ba natin o iiwasan?

text.EN: They're swarming. Are we cutting through or falling back?
text.TL: Dumudumog sila. Babasagin ba natin o aatras tayo?

text.EN: Too many bodies out there. What do you want to do?
text.TL: Napakaraming patay sa labas. Ano ang gusto mong gawin?

text.EN: Horde spotted. We taking them on or finding another route?
text.TL: May kawan sa unahan. Lalabanan ba natin o maghahanap ng ibang daan?

text.EN: Massive group approaching. Engage or evacuate?
text.TL: Napakalaking grupo ang papalapit. Lalaban o lilikas?

text.EN: That's a swarm. Give the order: fight or retreat?
text.TL: Kawan 'yan. Mag-utos ka: laban o urong?

text.EN: Look at that numbers disadvantage. Stand or withdraw?
text.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami nila laban sa atin. Tatayo o aatras?

text.EN: That's a lot of them. Stay close—fight or fall back?
text.TL: Ang dami nila. Dumikit ka—lalaban o uurong?

text.EN: Too many for comfort, friend. What's your gut say: fight or run?
text.TL: Masyadong marami para maging panatag, kaibigan. Anong kutob mo: laban o takbo?

text.EN: Stay right next to me. Do we take them together or get out?
text.TL: Manatili ka sa tabi ko. Sabay ba nating lalabanan o aalis tayo?

text.EN: That swarm is dangerous. I want us alive—fight or retreat?
text.TL: Delikado ang kawang 'yan. Gusto kong mabuhay tayo—laban o urong?

text.EN: I'm with you whatever you decide. Are we pushing through or retreating?
text.TL: Kasama mo ako kahit anong desisyon mo. Susulong ba tayo o aatras?

text.EN: Careful, partner. That's a massive pack. Call the play.
text.TL: Mag-ingat, kasama. Malaking kawan 'yan. Sabihin mo ang plano.

text.EN: Look out, friend! Do we clear them or save our strength and run?
text.TL: Mag-ingat, kaibigan! Uubusin ba natin sila o magtitipid ng lakas at tatakbo?

text.EN: They're everywhere. Stick by me—fight or fall back?
text.TL: Nasa lahat sila ng sulok. Dumikit ka—laban o urong?

text.EN: I trust your call. Are we taking this swarm on or heading back?
text.TL: Tiwala ako sa pasya mo. Lalabanan ba natin ang kawang ito o babalik?

text.EN: Big herd ahead. Don't worry, we're a team. What's the plan?
text.TL: Malaking kawan sa unahan. Huwag kang mag-alala, magkasama tayo. Anong plano?

text.EN: Horde. Fight or fall back?
text.TL: Kawan. Laban o urong?

text.EN: Too many. Call it: stand or run?
text.TL: Sobra sila. Magpasya: tayo o takbo?

text.EN: Swarm ahead. Fight or retreat?
text.TL: Kawan sa unahan. Laban o urong?

text.EN: Herd. What's the call?
text.TL: Kawan. Anong desisyon?

text.EN: Massive group. Push or pull?
text.TL: Malaking grupo. Sulong o urong?

text.EN: Numbers are bad. Engage?
text.TL: Masama ang bilang. Lalaban?

text.EN: Horde spotted. Decision now.
text.TL: Kawan nakita. Desisyon ngayon na.

text.EN: Dozens of them. Stand or flee?
text.TL: Dose-dosena sila. Lalaban o tatakas?

text.EN: Swarm incoming. Your call.
text.TL: Kawan parating. Pasya mo.

text.EN: Crowd ahead. Fight or back off?
text.TL: Grupo sa harap. Laban o atras?

text.EN: Big group ahead. We decide now: engage or avoid.
text.TL: Malaking grupo sa harap. Magpasya tayo ngayon: lumaban o umiwas.

text.EN: That horde will tear us apart if we hesitate. What's the move?
text.TL: Lalapain tayo ng kawang 'yan kapag nag-atubili tayo. Anong galaw?

text.EN: Bad odds. We fight with discipline or we slip away right now.
text.TL: Masamang tsansa. Lumaban nang may disiplina o tumakas agad ngayon.

text.EN: I'm not dying here. Decide: cut through or fall back?
text.TL: Di ako mamamatay dito. Magpasya ka: basagin o umatras?

text.EN: Check the numbers. Engage only if we have choke points.
text.TL: Tingnan mo ang dami. Lumaban lang kung may masisikipang daan.

text.EN: Horde is closing in. Make a choice before they surround us.
text.TL: Palapit na ang kawan. Pumili bago nila tayo mapaligiran.

text.EN: We can't afford mistakes against that herd. Stand or withdraw?
text.TL: Di tayo pwede magkamali sa kawang 'yan. Lalaban o aatras?

text.EN: Watch the flanks. Do we fight or get the hell out?
text.TL: Bantayan ang tagiliran. Lalaban ba tayo o aalis na agad?

text.EN: They'll overwhelm an open position. Call it now.
text.TL: Tatalunin nila tayo sa bukas na lugar. Magpasya ka na.

text.EN: Huge pack. If we fight, nobody breaks formation.
text.TL: Malaking kawan. Kung lalaban, walang sisira sa pormasyon.
